about: The FDV drawings (PLAN.md milestone 6) for tools/dxfimport.py, one entry a storey of a wing, once they arrive. Example: {"id": "sb-12", "file": "twin-pack/fdv/SB_plan12.dxf", "storey": "12. etasje", "wing": "sentralblokka", "kote": 58.11, "height": 3.76, "how": "fra FDV", "source": "Vestre Viken FDV, SB plan 12", "place": "utm", "walls": "(?i)vegg|wall", "rooms": "(?i)rom|room", "replaces": ["spor-sb-12"]}. place "cp" with cp "x,y,site_x,site_y;..." (drawing units) where the drawing is not in UTM 33. Keep the files themselves in twin-pack/fdv/ (not in the repo).
